verdict.rationale: Mesh lets users generate API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials and configure each credential's permissions and an optional expiry date. Those credentials authenticate via the OAuth2 client-credentials flow, which suits issuing a dedicated, scoped, time-limited credential to an agent. Missing for 10: documentation of permission granularity (which scopes or resources can be restricted), any agent-specific guidance, rotation/revocation detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
